images.prompt: Create one photorealistic editorial illustration for an African civil birth-registration checklist. Wide 3:2 landscape composition. In the foreground a parent's brown hand places a plain folder with a blank form and a pen on a modest, uncluttered civil-registration counter. Beside the parent a small infant wrapped securely in a soft pale green blanket is held comfortably, chiefly visible as a tiny hand and the folds of blanket. A registrar's hand receives the folder. Soft natural daylight, restrained warm neutral tones, calm documentary framing. It should read immediately as registering a new baby's birth. No readable text or numbers, no flags, crests, logos, seals, identity cards, passports, suitcases or visible identifying details. The family and setting are illustrative and geographically neutral for Kenya and Nigeria. Keep the main subjects within the central two-thirds for mobile landscape crops.
images.review: Visually reviewed the 3:2 family-and-infant scene, pen and unmarked form. No readable identity data, seals, flags or official office branding.
images.provenance: AI-generated editorial illustration of a family registering a birth. The people, form and office are illustrative.
